purpose: Freeze the external atmosphere and cloud-QC evidence hierarchy before target twilight radiance values are opened, while explicitly refusing to invent a post-hoc temporal AOD linkage rule.

primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.source: AERONET Version 3 Solar AOD Level 2.0 at Izana
primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.reason: Version 3 Level 2.0 applies automatic cloud/instrument QC plus pre-field and post-field calibrations and is the quality-assured solar AOD product.

aod550Derivation.method: Angstrom interpolation from independently measured AERONET spectral AOD

primaryQuantitativeAodAnchor.knownVisibleFieldInstrumentUncertaintyCo: published AERONET field-instrument AOD uncertainty is commonly about 0.01-0.02 in visible channels, larger toward UV; the final validation contract must use source/product-specific uncertainty rather than silently adopting this contextual range as a universal sigma

independentDaylightCorroboration.role: independent daylight AOD corroboration and calibration/stability diagnostic
independentDaylightCorroboration.publishedChannelUncertaintyContext: approximately 0.004 at 862 nm to 0.01 at 368 nm
independentDaylightCorroboration.publishedTraceabilityContext: long-term synchronous Izaña comparison found AERONET-Cimel and GAW-PFR highly traceable, especially outside the shortest UV channel

aeronetLunarV3.reason: published assessments describe lunar Level 1.5 AOD as provisional/not yet quality-assured and note weaker cirrus rejection at night
aeronetLunarV3.permittedRoleBeforeFurtherReview: independent temporal-stability diagnostic or corroboration only

otherNighttimePhotometry.note: historical Izaña star-photometer comparisons support feasibility of nocturnal AOD but no current public per-session product has yet been bound for this validation

cloudAndGlareQc.solarAodCloudQc: AERONET Version 3 Level 2.0 automatic cloud screening and instrument anomaly QC applies to the AOD anchor itself

primaryIndependentSkyContext.historicalSystemCapability: automated visible/infrared all-sky imaging day and night with cloud-fraction algorithms
primaryIndependentSkyContext.role: exclude or flag cloud/glare-contaminated twilight sessions using independent sky imagery/metadata

bsrn.role: independent radiation/context diagnostic where synchronized data are available

temporalLinkageGate.whyOpen: quality-assured solar AOD is measured by direct Sun and does not continue automatically through civil twilight; an arbitrary maximum age or extrapolation interval would create an unvalidated atmosphere assumption
mustFreezeBeforeOpening: maximum allowed elapsed time from the last quality-assured solar AOD anchor to each twilight observation OR a more defensible bracketing scheme
pre-sunset AOD stability statistic and rejection threshold
whether and how provisional lunar AOD may constrain temporal drift without becoming the sole AOD truth
how to inflate AOD550 uncertainty as elapsed time and observed AOD variability increase
whether post-twilight or next-morning evidence may be used and, if so, only under a rule frozen before target values are opened
automatic rejection when the atmosphere cannot be bounded within the ASIV AOD support box without extrapolation
forbidden: choose the AOD nearest to the model-predicted radiance
fit AOD or aerosol family to Pandora validation spectra
choose a max-age after seeing model residuals
use lunar AOD as quality-assured Level 2 when the product is not so classified
hide temporal AOD uncertainty inside the aerosol-family scenario envelope

separationOfUncertainties.pandoraRadiometricUncertainty: measurement uncertainty of the target radiance source

nextSafeWork.recommended: freeze a literature-justified temporal AOD linkage and uncertainty-inflation rule, then bind exact AERONET/GAW-PFR/SONA data-access fields before selecting sessions
